predict_steps.prompt: You may add ')' only when close_count is less than what?
predict_steps.hint: Never more closers than openers in a prefix.

predict_steps.prompt: For n=1, what is the only string returned?

viva.question: What constrains adding '(' versus ')' while building n pairs?
expected_points: you may add an opener only while fewer than n are open
you may add a closer only while closers stay below openers
those rules keep every prefix balanced enough to finish
violating either rule produces a string that can never become valid

viva.question: Why return the strings in lexicographic order?
expected_points: the statement demands a canonical sorted list
strict equality grading depends on that order
sorting at the end is enough if generation order differs
unsorted duplicates of the same set would look like a wrong answer

viva.question: Why never allow more closers than openers in any prefix?
expected_points: that prefix would already be invalid parentheses
there would be no opener left on a stack view to match the closer
the balance invariant forbids a negative running count
later openers cannot repair an earlier deficit
